_about: Supply boat (Track WS, 2026-10-10: water). ALEX'S (decisions water-layer and boat-looks): one unarmed supply boat, the S2 barge with deck cargo (34 m); 'part of the environment with real patrols but no specific part in the mission'. EVERYTHING ELSE HERE IS PROPOSED by Track WS. The same movement system as the patrol boat with a barge's numbers: slower (5 m/s, about 10 knots, a twentieth of a fighter's), a very slow turn, a deeper keel. It sails a route back and forth (scripts/sim/ai_pilot.gd role 'sail', mode 'shuttle'). The WATER RULE (World.set_water, data/sim/sea.json) applies as to the patrol boat. It has no weapons and carries no bombs; it can be hit, and at 0 health it is DESTROYED (fate 'destroyed': it stays where it was, down; the drawing may sink it).
